description: Read-only operator interface. Answers questions about why the fleet reached a decision, grounded in the ARMCL memory chain.

invocation.rationale: Queried by a person after a run, in its own session. Inside the graph it would charge every autonomous run for an explanation nobody requested.

tier1.rationale: Reads the scratchpad to describe it. Writing would let an explanation alter the run it describes.

tier2.rationale: The episodic ledger is the audit record. An auditor that can append to the log is not an auditor.

tier3.rationale: Surfaces durable constraints to explain a decision, but cannot create policy by describing it.

guardrails.rationale: Both directions screened: operator questions are untrusted input, and answers quote memory that may contain sensitive fragments.
